title: Circle Design Problems Lab
prompt: Model garden, label, and mat design problems with a labeled diagram, predict the area, reveal checks, and complete a mini-quiz.

fallback.markdown: The Circle Design Problems Lab asks you to choose a design scenario, label the radius or diameter, predict area, reveal the model, and complete quick checks. If the mini-app is unavailable, draw the model by hand, label the radius, choose the correct circle area expression, and explain the answer in square units.
